question: Customer lost their card, what do I do?
answer: 1. Check an original national ID, passport or driving licence. Compare photo and signature with account records before any other step. [CONTROL] | 2. Do not accept copies, photographs of documents or expired documents. [CONTROL] | 3. If someone else reports the loss, do not capture a replacement. Ask them to call the contact centre; ask the account holder to visit. [CONTROL] | 4. Customer completes and signs Form CB-01 and the officer countersigns it. Do not block the card or capture a replacement without it. [CONTROL] | 5. The customer states on the form the date and place the card was last used. [CONTROL] | 6. Tell the customer the card is blocked and any transaction after the block time will be declined. [CONTROL] | 8. When the new card arrives, check the original ID again and have the customer sign the collection register before handing over card and PIN mailer. [CONTROL] | 9.
